data.body:
[P2] Reconcile the changed preflight sequence in the design

The README and both MCP prompts say to run `test_destination` first, but these instructions explicitly start with data access. This matters for Athena: with `DURABLE_TELEMETRY_CONFIRMED_READONLY=true`, data tools skip the result-location check. If results are configured inside the table’s data location, querying adds files to that data; `test_destination` instead reports the problem without issuing its test query. Rule 7, “List the decisions that the task did not cover,” requires this behavioral change and its reason to be documented, but the description does not acknowledge it. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and reconcile the sequence; retaining the existing verify-first behavior is the simpler direction.
